questions.question: The type of rivet which is used to join the two plates without the need to make a through all the length of hole in the joining plates:

explanations.b: Split rivets can be used without drilling full length holes.
explanations.c: Round rivet is a head shape, not a type.
explanations.d: Incorrect because split rivet satisfies the condition.

questions.question: Important feature of the rivet for which it is mostly used:

explanations.a: Rivets are preferred due to simple construction and low cost.
explanations.b: Strength is important but not the primary feature.
explanations.c: Hardness is not a key requirement.

questions.question: The design related cause events does not include:

answers.b: Improper selection of the type of joint

explanations.b: Wrong joint selection is a design fault.
explanations.d: Proper size does not cause failure.

questions.question: The applications for the where strength, rigidity, as well as security against leakage should be considered:

answers.b: Boiler drains, pressure vessels, gas tanks

explanations.a: Not all pipe joints need leak proofing.
explanations.b: Such applications demand high strength and leak prevention.
explanations.c: Doors do not require leak resistance.
explanations.d: Incorrect because option B is most appropriate.

questions.question: A riveted joint may not fail during its service life by:

explanations.a: Tearing is a common failure mode.
explanations.b: Shearing is a common failure mode.
explanations.c: Bending is not a standard rivet failure mode.
